explanation: Matches Theorem 1.2 of Huang–Shi (arXiv 2504.17644v3): for K = F((t^-1)) with F finite of characteristic 3, 5, 7 or 11 and D the diagonal subgroup of SL_4(K), there is z in SL_4(K)/SL_4(F[t]) with Dz non-closed and relatively compact. `F⸨X⸩` with X = t^-1 is the same field, and Mathlib's `Valued` instance gives the X-adic topology, which is the topology of the paper's absolute value. `polyToLaurent` sends t to X^-1 and constants to constants, so it is the natural embedding of F[t]. Faithful.
